name: ledger
description: Ask about and update your Ledger personal-finance books: balances, net worth, spending, investments and income tax.

interface.shortDescription: Your personal-finance ledger: balances, spending, investments and tax
interface.longDescription: Ledger is a triple-entry bookkeeping app for personal finance in India. Connect it to ask about your net worth, account balances on any date, spending by category, investment returns and new-regime income tax, and to record, edit or tag transactions in the same structure you already use. Every change goes through the same validation, reconciliation locks and linked-account approvals as the web app, and returns the updated balances. Ledger is a record-keeping tool: it never moves money, contacts a bank or starts a payment.
defaultPrompt: What's my net worth, and how are my investments doing?
How much did I earn and spend last month?
What was my HDFC balance at the end of March?
